ModMetaData.name: Lattice
ModMetaData.author: SCPLEGION
ModMetaData.description: One dark, glassy style with a gold accent: centered icon dock, floating architect window, cinematic main menu with your colony as the background, one-click bills tab, and restyled buttons, windows, tabs, mods screen, colonist bar, alerts and inspect pane. Grids are built from live defs, so modded content shows up automatically.
